summary.text: Steve Wood (listed on Ballotpedia as Stephen Wood) is a Republican state representative who has represented Maine House District 92 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A U.S. Navy veteran and business owner, he previously served in the House from 2010 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Wood is a veteran of the U.S. Navy.

His career experience includes owning and operating a sporting camp and working as a registered Maine guide, and he has been affiliated with Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 135 and Webster Mason Lodge 164.
Wood served in the Maine House of Representatives from District 57 from 2010 to 2018 and returned to the chamber for District 92 in December 2022, succeeding Ann Matlack.
In 2023 and 2024 he was assigned to the House Engrossed Bills Committee and the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife Committee, and for 2025 and 2026 to the House Engrossed Bills Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
